# AI Configuration

## Rules

- Always update tests when changing behaviour.
- Always update tests when changing behaviour.
- Never commit secrets or credentials to the repository.
- The project uses pnpm.
- This repo uses TypeScript.
- The package manager is pnpm.
- Use pnpm to install packages.
- Use pnpm, not npm.
- Use pnpm for all installs.
- Prefer pnpm over npm.
- Use strict TypeScript settings.
- Always run tests before merging.
- Always run tests before committing.
- Ensure CI passes before merging.
- Ensure CI passes before requesting review.
- Write meaningful commit messages.
- Write clear commit messages.
- Commit messages should be descriptive.
- Do not use console.log in production code.
- Avoid console.log in production.
- Remove console.log before committing.
- Always add JSDoc to public functions.
- Always document public APIs.
- Public APIs must have JSDoc comments.
- Document all exported functions.
- Use English for all documentation.
- All docs should be in English.
- Documentation language is English.
- Never introduce breaking changes without a major version bump.
- Breaking changes require a major version bump.
- Use semantic versioning.
- Follow semver.
